verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's agent connects to the customer's ticketing system and internal tools to ingest data, and it acts through the customer's own APIs and MCP servers inside workflows. Server-side identity validation and customer isolation imply that tool calls are tied to the specific customer, so answers can draw on per-customer system data rather than help articles alone. missing for 10: explicit documentation of live lookups of plan, order status and account history in answers; worked examples beyond a hypothetical order-status tool prompt; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, answers use the customer's live data — plan, order status, account history — not just generic help articles

citations.quote: The agent takes action through your APIs and MCP servers inside natural-language and deterministic workflows
Connect Lorikeet in seconds to your ticketing system, knowledge base, and internal tools to seamlessly ingest data and take action for your customers
Customer isolation, server-side identity validation, workflow-scoped tool access and hard execution caps are enforced in code rather than prompts
